name: Anna's Wedding Planning & Consulting
primary_cta: Request your wedding date (booking request summary + tap to call Nassau or the US line)
brand_truth: One experienced Bahamian planner, Annamae Fox, two decades of beach and cruise-day weddings in Nassau, published prices from USD 875, the licence paperwork handled.
buyer: US, Canadian and international couples planning a Nassau beach or cruise-day wedding on a phone months ahead; fear licence mistakes, a planner who stops answering, hidden costs.

direction.type: T09 Didone fashion (Bodoni Moda + Jost, self-hosted)
direction.why: The five kinds of wedding with prices become a permanent index that swaps Anna's own photograph, so the buyer's real question (which package, what price) is the structure. Shallow-water aqua and sand are the colours of every photo she owns. A Didone is bridal-magazine type, more refined than Gloock + Figtree. P03 conch pink refused: Bahamas Bridal Affairs (competitor) uses it.

concept_type: packages with booking request (no cart, no payment; verified on /book-now)
big_idea: The offer is the index: Anna's five kinds of wedding sit in a permanent left index like a bridal atelier's catalogue; touch one and her own photograph of that wedding fills the page, and the package finder turns how you arrive and who comes into one published price.
critic_kind: self-critique only: no subagent tool was available in this run, so no independent critic scored it
current_site_findings: Booking form and package pages disagree on three prices (Romantic 3,295 vs 3,995; Blue Ocean 6,645 vs 7,645; Tropical 10,595 vs 13,895).
Cultural, Deluxe and Renewal prices exist only inside booking-form dropdowns.
Best photo (2025 rose arbor) buried; homepage slider uses faded composite banners and repeats 'Dream Wedding Services'.
Most photos date from 2015 and load over http.
Cruise purser-letter rule on a separate page; no email or WhatsApp published.
pitch_line: Your fifteen packages, one honest price list and your own best photographs, arranged so a couple abroad finds their package and asks for their date in two taps.
assumptions: Package-page prices used where the booking form disagrees (Romantic 3,995, Blue Ocean 7,645, Tropical 13,895): confirm which is current.
Cultural, Deluxe and Renewal prices from the booking form; inclusions not published.
Annamae Fox is the Anna of the business (Instagram profile name).
Both phone numbers current; which takes WhatsApp unknown; no email published.
Licence rules as published by Anna; confirm with the Registrar General.
The vow renewal photo in the index is a generic Anna wedding photo (her Blue Ocean package image), not a renewal.
notes: Gen-2 rebuild 2026-11-20, kept the gen-1 structure Balazs liked (package finder with arrival mode and guest slider, licence checklist, published prices, date request) and rebuilt everything else: Bodoni Moda + Jost self-hosted (replaces Gloock + Figtree), fixed left index of the five wedding kinds that swaps the hero photo on hover, bigger photography (half-screen hero, 78svh spread), aqua field for licence and footer. BLIND: look.mjs, Wikimedia and outside images blocked; Anna's photos were seen through a Lovable contact-sheet project (ip-assets-anna-wedding, about 1.5 Lovable credits, no generation) and its screenshot crops were routed into Playwright for my own QA screenshots (low-res crops, the real hero is 2560px). No reference screenshots (blocked); references judged from knowledge (aesop.com index, belmond weddings). No subagent tool was available, so the critic step was a self-critique: first pass found repetitive 5/7 two-column rhythm and a CTA ('Check your wedding date') identical to Bahamas Bridal Affairs; fixed (licence restructured full-width with two-column checklist, CTA now 'Request your wedding date'), re-shot and re-scored. State is needs-review because no independent critic scored it. qa.mjs dead-space blocker is a false positive: the index column is position:fixed and full height on every screen, but a full-page screenshot draws it only once at the top. qa tap-target warning is the shared concept ribbon button. interact.mjs 'dead input' is the range slider receiving text input (works with real input). No 3D (standard tier).
